notes.title: DEIDTHRAW | 1.0.0 Full Release
notes.content:
[h1][b]After a year of development, I'm pleased to release Deidthraw 1.0.0![/b][/h1]

[b]With 106 additional Skills & Passive abilities, a new boss, 2 new enemy types, 1 new weapon, map mini-expansion and a full weapon upgrade system having been added since launch Deidthraw is now mechanically complete!

However, much like the game itself, the end is not the end, at least for actual content :) All being well, another winter-themed map is on the way, and little Ad-hoc content additions (weapons and such), although those are a little further in the future![/b]

[b]Thanks so much for all the feedback on this simultaneous Debut & First commercial release of mine![/b]


[h2][b]| NEW PLAYABLE CONTENT |[/b][/h2]

Tinseltown Mini Expansion
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0	The Soul cave has been added to the Tinseltown
1.1	Weapons can now be upgraded in Tinseltown just the same as Oldtown
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]| QOL |[/b][/h2]

Rare skill cost reduced to 33 (was 50)
Epic Skill Cost reduced to 100 (was 125)
Legendary Skill cost reduced to 200 (was 225)
Pub Door now has a particle effect

Objective tracker has been added to Tinseltown Correctly
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0	Simplified Objectives now display and remain on the screen
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]| AI & Balancing |[/b][/h2]

Re-adjustment of Enemy AI Speeds and movements
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0	Enemies speed min/max brackets at all ranks have all been reduced slightly
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: DEIDTHRAW | The Satisfaction Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]| NEW PLAYER EXPERIENCE CONTENT UPDATE |[/b][/h2]

The tutorial has been fixed and is now officially available in the game!
Opening cinematic is now available

New Armoured Enemy Variant – The armoured Immune
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0	Is immune to holy pulse and vaporisation damage
1.1 Is immune to the slowing and health reduction effects of the Crystalice infusion
1.2 Always has the highest possible armour count
1.3 Has an additional +50 to their base speed over regular armoured enemies
1.4 Unique golden glowing helmet
1.5 5% chance to spawn instead of a regular armoured enemy
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]| QOL |[/b][/h2]

DeidSprite Miniboss visual elements have been moved upward for better visibility
All Keys now have an ambient sound, light and camera shake effect when the player is nearby :)

Skills update cost finalisations 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0 Epic Skills cost increased to 125 each (was 100)
1.1 Legendary skills costs reduced to 225 each (was 250)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Upgrade selection now has an associated particle effect for better visual confirmation of Upgrade choice

[h2][b]| AI & Balancing |[/b][/h2]

The effect of the following changes means that general frustration for new players should be reduced while also making alterations to the difficulty which has increased somewhat. However this has significantly reduced “waiting” times, given more power to infusions such as Crystalice for speed slowing at higher ranks and made the purchasing of ammo and Medkits when you have fewer skills more necessary.

Rework of the Enemy AI movement and navigation system
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0 Enemy AI now navigates to a more general position while further away from the player which significantly decreases the previous ‘lining up’ effect of the pinpoint positional targeting
1.1 Enemy AI’s player targeting now narrows when nearby the player
1.2 Enemy AI’s will now navigate faster when further away from the target player
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Re-adjustment of Enemy AI Speed system
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0 Enemies speed min/max brackets have been widened
1.1 Enemy speed now has an additional randomiser adjustment step to reduce clumping
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Player Collision Capsule size has been increased to reduce how often the player is out of the navigable area and thus unreachable by AI

General Skeleton Starting HP decreased to 150 (was 175)
General Skeleton HP gain decreased to 45% (was 50%)
Bomber Skeleton Explosions now remove 10 Deid armour charges each

DeidSprite Miniboss HP gain now matches general skeletons and is now 45% (was 15%)
DeidSprite Miniboss collision capsule increased to 30 (was 15)
DeidSprite Miniboss now deals 10% MaxHP + 2.5 x Your Current rank as damage to you (was 5)

DeidFae Maximum starting ammo reduced to 200 (was 333)
DeidFrost Maximum starting ammo reduced to 132 (was 222)
Eusten Mk.II Maximum starting ammo reduced to 128 (was 160)
Glenburry H.H Maximum starting ammo reduced to 30 (was 50)
Lewis Firing delay slowed to 0.175 (was 0.125)


[h2][b]| AUDIO |[/b][/h2]

Dodging now has an associated activation SFX
Objective Key SFX has been revamped
Eusten (Silenced) Fire SFX has been revamped
DeLisle Fire SFX has been revamped
Lewis Fire SFX has been revamped
Howell Fire SFX has been revamped
Eusten (Unsilenced) Fire SFX has been revamped
Lanchester Fire SFX has been revamped
Webley Fire SFX has been revamped
CoinPickup SFX has been revamped
Purchase SFX has been revamped
Rank Up and Upgrade selection SFX have been revamped
Various volume adjustments

[h2][b]| Bug Fixes |[/b][/h2]

Ammo usage counter has been fixed so revolvers correctly release the right number of used shells when you fire free shots
Infinite loop has been fixed that occasionally caused no ammo to ever be used
Powered shots now only activate if you have the associated skill tree perks purchased as intended
Deidfire causing the powered shot particle to activate backward has been fixed
Initial Rank Up SFX buffer priority increased and should now always play
Coin Pickup SFX buffer priority increased and recover time adjusted so should now always play
A few more Cheat spots have been patched out.

notes.title: PreSkills UPDATE – NEW SYSTEMS, REBALANCE [V0.991 B]
notes.content:
[b]This adds a few new systems and rebalances rather dramatically in preparation for the upcoming skill/upgrade tree update so the game will feel more difficult in some ways but should even out on the next patch![/b]

[b]| NEW SYSTEMS |[/b]
Random Resource Drops
Skill and random upgrades synergise
Personal Deid Armour 
Armoured Enemies
Armour shred

[b]| AUDIO |[/b]
All Weapon Maximum SFX volume lowered 
Skeletal Bombers Ticker SFX volume has been increased drastically

[b]| Balance changes |[/b]
Significant reduction in total number of skeletons spawning at once. Has also provided for minor performance increases.
Deidsouls are now gained twice as fast
Armoured skeleton horde now appear from at rank 5/15/25 etc
Small amounts of armoured skeletons will appear at random from rank 11 onwards
Skeletal bombers now only appear from rank 10/20/30 etc 
Critical Hit Chance Random Upgrade Values Decreased Was [5.5,10,17.5,33] Is now [2.5,5,10,20]
Skeleton HP gain per deid rank has doubled from 25% per rank to 50% per rank 
Dodge Invincibility is now a purchasable skill and no longer a default ability.
Coin Pickup amounts reduced to original launch values. Was (10,15,25) is now (5,10,15)
Medkits base cost increased to 750 (was 500)

[b]| Bug Fixes |[/b]
Ability shrine no longer provides abilities for 999 crowns instead of 25 Machined Parts and materials
Enemy avoidance radius has been halved (should reduce the amount of sliding into walls)
A few more Cheat spots have been patched out.
Fixed Medkits often not charging you the purchase price

notes.content:
| Bug Fixes |

Pressing 'Q' / 'O' Key no longer disables the HUD, improves experience for non qwerty keyboard layouts

notes.title: Launch Patch 7 [Last of 2023] - QOL Improvements, Audio changes
notes.content:
[b]| This is the final launch patch, updates and larger content additions will restart from Jan 3rd 2024, Happy Holidays 😊 |[/b]


[b]| Quality of Life |[/b]

A Danger ‘Audio-stinger’ has been added, this will activate when something is behind or to the side of you. preventing things sneaking up on you without any warning.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0 Danger Warning audio stinger added
1.1 Stinger will only activate if you are currently standing still or have only been moving for 0.5 seconds or less.
1.2 Similarly stinger will not activate at all if you are sprinting, this prevents it going off as you move around enemies that you are already aware of.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Enemy  navigation settings have been adjusted slightly to decrease the level of conga lining going on and hopefully reduce how often you get trapped. [ This will continue to be adjusted going forward, until a good balance is found. ]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0 Avoidance weight lowered
1.1 Avoidance distance increased from 15.456cm to 100cm
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[b]| Audio |[/b]

Medkits now have a purchase SFX

Enemy Footstep sound has been changed and their volume has been increased in the mix

External Artillery volume has been decreased slightly

Player personal footstep sounds volume has been increased in the mix


[b]| Bug Fixes | [/b]

You can’t shoot through the wall at untriggered enemies in the pub before they are activated anymore.

notes.title: Launch Patch 6 - Mini Content Update & QOL changes
notes.content:
[b]| Mini Content Update |[/b]

NEW WEAPON – DeidFrost has been added to the ability shrine. It also replaces the DeidFae magic weapon at the centre of Tinseltown


[b]| Quality of Life |[/b]

Exploding skeletons Damage calculation has been changed to prevent instant kills and makes taking health upgrades more useful.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0	Explosion auto activation damage ( I.E The damage taken when you are too close ) is now 33% of your max health + the enemy’s base damage to you + 25.
1.1 This however means they will no longer do damage to surrounding skeletons
1.2 Explosion damage from purposeful activation, I.E Deliberate or Accidental headshots for an AOE clear remains the same.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


DeidHeart Entity base health has been reduced and the total damage per hit has been clamped. In essence making the early game easier using worse weapons and the late game more difficult as better weapons are less effective.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.0	Max health reduced from 25,000 to 17,500
1.1 Damage taken clamped to 1000 per hit/shot
1.2 Damage Max Clamping increases 150dmg per Player Deid Rank
1.3 % Health gain per players Deid rank achieved has been decreased from 20% to 15%
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
